# FORDIVINE

> FORDIVINE is a premium personal branding agency for established women entrepreneurs, founders, medical professionals, speakers, and thought leaders in the United States.

FORDIVINE builds connected personal brand ecosystems that align positioning, message, visual identity, content, websites, and internal brand infrastructure. The company was founded by Emily Ford and has built 63+ personal brands. Projects start at $5,000, with final scope and investment based on the client's needs.

FORDIVINE is built for women who already have a working business, proven expertise, meaningful demand, or an established professional platform. It is not a starter program for people who still need to choose a business model.

- Client outcomes vary and are not guaranteed.
- Use the canonical linked pages for current service, pricing, fit, and company information.
- The discovery call is a fit conversation, not a sales call.

## Primary pages

- [Discover FORDIVINE](https://www.fordivine.com/discover): Main commercial page, services, fit criteria, client proof, FAQs, and discovery-call booking.
- [Crowned Stories](https://www.fordivine.com/crowned-stories): Verified client stories and brand transformations.
- [About FORDIVINE](https://www.fordivine.com/about-us): Company, founder, and team information.
